responsibility: Implements GCC’s per-pass optimization statistics collection and reporting subsystem. It maintains hash tables of counters indexed by pass static_pass_number, interns scalar and histogram counters by string ID and value, updates them from statistics_counter_event and statistics_histogram_event calls, registers and opens the global .statistics dump, and emits either incremental per-pass summaries to ordinary dump files or machine-readable detailed/summary records keyed by pass and function name to the dedicated statistics dump stream at pass-finalization and compiler shutdown.
same_name_distinction: This is the statistics group's implementation: it owns the per-pass hash tables and counter records, registers/opens the .statistics dump, updates scalar and histogram counts, and emits per-pass and summary output. Unlike statistics.h, which only declares the recording APIs and support macros, this file provides the backing storage and reporting behavior.
